preconditions.description: The length of str1 must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of str2 must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str1)
preconditions.description: str1 must consist only of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: str2 must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The returned string must have both str1 and str2 as subsequences.
The length of the returned string must not exceed the sum of the lengths of str1 and str2.
